lines.text: Late night conversations, coffee in the morning glow
You say the perfect things and suddenly I know
I was spinning in my head, you pulled me back so easily
Now every little moment feels like destiny
You don’t even know the power that you hold
Every time you smile, my walls just fold
You’re the frequency of you, the only one that tunes me right
You’re the rhythm in my chest that beats all through the night
Every time you call my name, I remember who I am
You’re the frequency of you… frequency of you
